def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    edge_values={grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if (r in (0,h-1) or c in (0,w-1)) and grid[r][c]!=0}
    border=next(iter(edge_values))
    other=sorted(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,border)))
    counts={v:sum(x==v for row in grid for x in row) for v in other}
    inner=min(other,key=lambda v:counts[v])
    middle=next(v for v in other if v!=inner)
    out=[[border if r in (0,h-1) or c in (0,w-1) else middle for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    coords=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==inner]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in coords),max(r for r,c in coords)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in coords),max(c for r,c in coords)
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1): out[r][c]=inner
    return out
